props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the colour, and the swatch it came from — undefined for a custom colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the radio group.

props.name: allowCustom
props.description: Offer a native colour input after the palette.

props.name: customLabel
props.description: Name for the custom colour control.

props.name: showName
props.description: Show the chosen colour’s name under the swatches.

props.name: columns
props.description: Swatches per row. Up and Down move by a row. Omit to wrap freely and step by one.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.
